# PODHOD

> Your personal workout program and tracker. A bilingual (English/Russian)
> exercise library of 1,324 movements with step-by-step instructions, and a
> program builder with per-exercise progression schemes (linear, double
> progression, RPE, fixed weight).

## Pages

- [Home](https://podhod-workout.cc/): overview and most popular exercises
- [Exercise library](https://podhod-workout.cc/library): searchable, filterable by body part
- [Blog](https://podhod-workout.cc/blog): short articles on training basics

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BoikoAnastasiia/podhod)
